characters.name: Alex
characters.appearance: Muscular male cyclist, yellow jersey, black shorts, aerodynamic helmet, intense expression

characters.name: Ben
characters.appearance: Lean male cyclist, green jersey, black shorts, aerodynamic helmet, focused expression

scenes.setting: winding mountain road, sunny day, sparse trees

shots.description: Wide shot of two cyclists, rider_yellow and rider_green, side-by-side, speeding down a winding mountain road.
Medium shot of rider_yellow leaning into a turn, slightly ahead, pushing hard.
Medium shot of rider_green gaining ground, eyes fixed forward, muscles straining.

scenes.setting: straight stretch of mountain road, approaching finish

shots.description: Low angle close-up of the front wheels of both bikes, almost touching, spinning rapidly.
Over-shoulder shot from behind rider_yellow, showing rider_green's helmet and shoulder right next to them.

scenes.setting: finish line banner across the road, small crowd cheering

shots.description: Wide shot of both cyclists crossing the finish line simultaneously, arms slightly raised in exhaustion.
Close-up of rider_yellow and rider_green's faces, side-by-side, panting but with a shared look of respect and triumph.
